title: Repair and shared verification fencing
behavioral_concerns: A repair mutation immediately makes prior performance flow evidence stale.
Persisted repair reverification rejects incomplete passing authority, malformed performance identities, invalid outcomes, excessive blocker text, or missing cleanup proof.
Previously passing performance evidence triggers post-functional repair reverification; a miss, inconclusive result, stale authority, or uncertain cleanup prevents repair verification.
QA, reproduction, and repair continue to enforce shared verification writer ownership without weakening existing fencing.

evidence.summary: Repair performance reverification stores target results, but persisted-state validation does not inspect those results or validate their nested outcomes.

theories.claim: ValidateRepairReverification accepts persisted performance reverification records whose nested target results contain invalid performance outcomes or malformed target data because it validates only top-level performance fields and never validates TargetResults.
theories.basis: qa-v1-block-32fed93c9abfff4d8a2ce8f3 shows that ValidateRepairReverification validates only top-level performance fields and passing authority, while qa-v1-block-a4433213f2515f9d53c23882 defines persisted TargetResults and qa-v1-block-263b3a5636c57033d940e0e1 defines valid performance outcomes.
theories.confirmation_condition: A RepairReverification with valid top-level performance authority fields but a TargetResults entry containing an invalid comparison outcome or malformed target identity is accepted by ValidateRepairReverification.
theories.refutation_condition: Validation reached by ValidateRepairReverification validates every TargetResults entry, including target identity and comparison outcome.
theories.inconclusive_condition: Omitted source contains indirect target-result validation that is invoked by ValidateRepairReverification but is not visible in the supplied blocks.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Inspect the complete validator or use an existing product-owned validation test that passes a malformed TargetResults entry to ValidateRepairReverification without writing persisted state.
